newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish 14-day revrepo rate down by end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish 14-day revrepo rate down by end-96.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland's 14-day repo rate, last at 19.13 percent, is expected to fall to 18.36 percent by year end, a Reuter poll of Poland's 24 biggest banks showed.
The forecast is a mean average of bank' predictions ranging from 17.20 to 19.00 percent.
Last month, banks had expected the 14-day rate to fall to 18.84 percent by the end of the year.
Banks predicted the rate would average 19.00 percent this month. Forecasts ranged from 18.50 to 19.30 percent. @
By September 1997, banks expected the rate to fall to 16.46 percent. Predictions ranged from 14.5 to 17.50 percent.
